development_note: declared read-only under the integrator's hold, before any rustc, RustGM, probe or build run of these files; the design is 5b1-notice-20261109.md, which applies the approved 5b notice and asks six corrections (2a-2f). An amendment, if any, is recorded beside this file before the run it governs, and a failed prediction is kept with its amendment.
rule: Version-13 declaration tag 13 Constant; one constant header row per tag-13 declaration in declaration order after the enum columns, `ty | value` with value `0` or `1 | term` (K's term codec, in place); value code 17 `(17, [Declaration(const)])` read as `ValueKind::Constant`. Every consumer validates the term with K's canonical check, requires a free const to carry a tag-0 value of its declared scalar type, checks each code-17 value's type against its declaration's header, installs the header type as the declaration's cell and seeds the value as a completed evaluator definition, as legacy imported scalar constants are.
